description: This source file defines the class DeleteFeatureDefinitionResponse, which is a final, immutable class representing the response to a delete feature definition command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, serializing/deserializing to/from JSON, and managing headers and identifying information related to the delete feature operation.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a delete feature definition command, encapsulating the Thing ID, feature ID, headers, and providing JSON serialization/deserialization functionality.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DeleteFeatureDefinitionResponse instance with typed ThingId, featureId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of DeleteFeatureDefinitionResponse from a JSON string or object along with headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID whose definition was deleted.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns a JSON Pointer referencing the resource path for the deleted feature's definition.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.
